searchText: Hi I have some discovery bug. Teku affected, Prysm affected, Lighthouse is not affected by my code review and tests. I've tried attack with it and it was not successful, discovery is using only one thread in Teku, something similar in Prysm and memory usage is not increasing. But it's still a bug. Where should I report, directly to Teku and Prysm, or I could create issue in Attacknet github? random packet -> <- whoareyou malformed authheadermessage packet -> malformed authheadermessage packet (same) -> malformed authheadermessage packet (same) -> malformed authheadermessage packet (same) -> correct authheadermessage packet -> will pass for Teku/Prysm they are not dropping session from first malformed authheader and authheader has ec curve verify, which is expensive even for bad packet and 5.1 adds only aes above which is way cheaper than ec curve oh interesting I think an issue in our repo is fine for this, would make it easier to tracl *track You're sending the malformed authheader and making the server check the secp256k1 Sig? yeah i modify idNonce its check is last both in Teku and Prysm this sounds like a bug to me yeah its definitely a bug I will create issues both in Teku and Prysm githubs so I have test for go Right. So yeah, if we get a bad packet we drop a session the send a whoareyou so you have to repeat? perfect, thanks a lot 👍 <@!498009160982724610> yeah, I think it will be correct. Lighthouse doing it this way already https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/issues/7346 Thanks ! <@!539495253418180618> and I were hitting similar discv5 problems, thought it was a user error on our side, interesting Teku https://github.com/PegaSysEng/teku/issues/2846 <@!425907307621122049> in Nimbus the session isn't dropped either in discv5, but I actually realized this when implementing discv5.1 and adjusted it in the new implementation. I'll do the same fix in the older discv5.0 code too considering it will be used a while still. The idNonce check however did always happen before the signature check. But in discv5.1 that is something that is not being passed anymore in the handshake. anyway you could change which part of AuthHeaderMessagePacket to break, it's not limited to idNonce, so dropping the session is the best

Hi
I  have some discovery bug. Teku affected, Prysm affected, Lighthouse is not affected by my code review and tests.
I've tried attack with it and it was not successful, discovery is using only one thread in Teku, something similar in Prysm and memory usage is not increasing. But it's still a bug.
Where should I report, directly to Teku and Prysm, or I could create issue in Attacknet github?
